prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1288; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, if that's okay. You can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you confirm where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Houston, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the front entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had my foot on the brake and was backing out slowly. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and then there was a jolt from the rear right side of my car.

Q: Was your vehicle moving when the other car made contact?
A: Yes, I was rolling backward at maybe two or three miles an hour. The other car was coming down the lane behind me, going a bit faster than I'd expect for a lot.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: No. I didn't see it until after the impact. My view was blocked by the column next to my space.

Q: Did you get out and speak with the other driver?
A: Yes, briefly. They apologized and said they were looking at their phone. We exchanged insurance information.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to the left. My lower back aches when I sit for long periods. I felt it the next morning more than right away.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the following day. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm trying to keep up with my therapy appointments, and I'm happy to send over the records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
